knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A missed dose is not doubled without vet direction. The sitter calls the owner or vet for guidance and records the refusal and the call.
A change in health takes priority over the routine. The sitter records the observations, calls the owner and vet, and follows their advice.
The lesson says a pet sitter follows the owner's written routine, not the sitter's own habits.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate follow a simulated written routine and record each step with the time
Assessor observes the candidate check a simulated medicine label against the written instructions before a dose, and record the dose
Assessor presents a simulated change in health and observes the candidate record it, call the simulated owner and vet, and follow the advice
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Visit log with the routine steps and times
Medication dose log with label check and time
Record of the simulated call to the owner or vet, and the advice given
stopWorkCriteria: A human medicine is given to an animal
A missed dose is doubled without written vet direction
A change in health is not reported to the owner or vet
